attackers_goals: Obtain access to cryptocurrency stored in the wallet.
description: An unusual process has accessed files belonging to a cryptocurrency wallet.
investigative_actions: Determine whether it is legitimate for the process to access such files. Analyze the process/application that accessed the file. Check for any other suspicious actions that were performed by the process. Audit the usage of the cryptocurrency stored in the wallet.
name: Unusual process accessed a crypto wallet's files
required_data: XDR Agent with eXtended Threat Hunting (XTH)
